newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trade minister says will not attend WTO meet.
newsitem.headline: Japan trade minister says will not attend WTO meet.

text.p: Japan's Trade Minister Shinji Sato, troubled by a bribery scandal involving officials of his ministry, said on Thursday he would be unable to attend the World Trade Organisation ministerial conference this month.

"It is extremely regrettable," Sato told a news conference at which he announced that six senior officials of his ministry had been reprimanded for failing to properly supervise staff and for accepting excessive favours from an oil broker arrested on suspicion of tax evasion.
Sato is expected to face tough questions in parliament on the scandal, hence his decision to skip the WTO meeting.
The WTO conference is scheduled from December 9-13 in Singapore.
